description: This file manages the creation and configuration of various DETR object detection models, providing functions to instantiate models with specific backbones, pretrained weights, and additional post-processing. It includes utilities for different ResNet configurations, as well as panoptic variants.

methods.name: _make_detr(backbone_name: str, dilation=False, num_classes=91, mask=False)
methods.description: Factory function to create a DETR model with specified backbone, dilation, and number of classes, optionally wrapping it with segmentation capabilities.

methods.name: detr_resnet50(pretrained=False, num_classes=91, return_postprocessor=False)
methods.description: Constructs a DETR model with a ResNet-50 backbone, optionally loading pretrained weights, and returning a post-processed version if specified.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_dc5(pretrained=False, num_classes=91, return_postprocessor=False)
methods.description: Constructs a DETR-DC5 model with ResNet-50 backbone with dilation, optionally loading pretrained weights.

methods.name: detr_resnet101(pretrained=False, num_classes=91, return_postprocessor=False)
methods.description: Constructs a DETR model with ResNet-101 backbone, optionally with pretrained weights.

methods.name: detr_resnet101_dc5(pretrained=False, num_classes=91, return_postprocessor=False)
methods.description: Constructs a DETR-DC5 model with ResNet-101 backbone with dilation.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_panoptic( pretrained=False, num_classes=250, threshold=0.85, return_postprocessor=False )
methods.description: Creates a panoptic variant of DETR with ResNet-50 backbone, including segmentation support.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_dc5_panoptic( pretrained=False, num_classes=250, threshold=0.85, return_postprocessor=False )
methods.description: Creates a panoptic DETR-DC5 with ResNet-50 backbone and dilation.

methods.name: detr_resnet101_panoptic( pretrained=False, num_classes=250, threshold=0.85, return_postprocessor=False )
methods.description: Creates a panoptic DETR with ResNet-101 backbone.
